_meta.issuer_np: नेपाल सरकार / अर्थ मन्त्रालय / आन्तरिक राजस्व विभाग
_meta.issuer_en: Government of Nepal / Ministry of Finance / Inland Revenue Department
_meta.artifact: मूल्य अभिवृद्धि कर नियमावली, २०५३ (VAT Rules, 2053) — Schedule 10, pages 70-73
_meta.artifact_corroboration: Nepal Law Commission repository (watermark 'नेपाल कानून आयोग' / www.lawcommission.gov.np visible on every rendered page). The IRD taxpayer portal's E-VAT Return Entry screen carries the identical header (अनुसूची-१०, नियम २६ को उपनियम (१), मूल्य अभिवृद्धि कर विवरण फारम).
_meta.read_by: Pages 70, 71, 72 and 73 were rendered and read directly. Every box number, Devanagari label, and — critically — which of the three value columns is enterable (white) vs blocked (shaded) was taken from the rendered form, not from any secondary description.
amendments_printed_on_form: p.70 footnote (*): नेपाल राजपत्रमा मिति २०७३।७।२४ मा प्रकाशित सूचनाद्वारा हेरफेर गरिएको — the form header was amended by Gazette notice of 2073/07/24 BS.
p.72 footnote (⌀), attached to box 9: मिति २०७७।०६।१९ को नेपाल राजपत्रमा प्रकाशित सूचनाद्वारा संशोधित — box 9 was amended by Gazette notice of 2077/06/19 BS.
_meta.language: Every field label on the form is Nepali (Devanagari). The only English token anywhere on the form is 'USER ID' in the signature/office block (p.73).
_meta.filing_channel: IRD taxpayer portal WEB-FORM ENTRY ONLY. IRD publishes no upload schema/template for the VAT return itself, and no XML/JSON/CSV return-file upload path exists. Verified from IRD's own 'VAT return help file' (taxpayerportal.ird.gov.np/Help/) — whose documented flow is E-VAT Return Entry → submission number (70000000****) → manual data entry → Save → validate → Submit — and independently re-checked by two adversarial searches which failed to find any contradicting primary source. The sales/purchase REGISTER (अनुसूची-९ / अनुसूची-८) is a SEPARATE Excel upload for taxpayers on IRD's mandatory-upload list; its column schema could NOT be verified and is therefore NOT implemented by ZeroBook.
_meta.rounding_instruction_np: यदि यस अवधिमा कारोवार नगरेको भए तलको महलमा शुन्य राखेर विवरणमा हस्ताक्षर गर्नुहोस् । रु.१ भन्दा घटि भएमा पैसालाई रु.१ मा मिलान गरी विवरण भर्नुहोला ।
_meta.rounding_instruction_en: If no transaction took place in this period, put zero in the columns below and sign the return. If [an amount] is less than Re. 1, adjust the paisa to Re. 1 when filling the return.
_meta.rounding_implementation: Amounts are reported in WHOLE RUPEES. A non-zero amount that would round to 0 is reported as 1 (or -1 when negative), per the sentence above. A genuinely zero amount stays 0.

period_model.selection: The month is chosen by ticking one cell of a grid (जुन महिनाको हो त्यसमा (√) चिन्ह लगाउनुहोस्).
period_model.calendar: Bikram Sambat. The grid lists the months in FISCAL order (Shrawan → Ashadh), not BS calendar order (Baishakh = BS month 1, so Shrawan = BS month 4).
period_model.serialization_caveat: The form prescribes NO serialized period string, and the portal's live period field is behind taxpayer login. ZeroBook therefore identifies a period as an explicit BS calendar year + BS month number (e.g. 2082-04 = Shrawan 2082) and never emits an invented portal format string.

not_tracked_by_zerobook: 1.2 निर्यात (Export) — ZeroBook does not classify a sale as an export; reported as 0.
1.3 छुट विक्री (Exempt sales) — no exempt-supply flag exists on a ledger or stock item; reported as 0.
2.2 कर लाग्ने पैठारी (Taxable import) — imports are not distinguished from domestic purchases; the whole taxable purchase lands in 2.1 and 2.2 is 0.
2.3 छुट खरिद / 2.4 छुट पैठारी (Exempt purchase / import) — not classified; reported as 0.
3.1 अन्य थपघट (Other adjustments) — bad-debt relief, scrapped-asset VAT etc. are not modelled; reported as 0.

6 गत महिनाको मिलान गर्न बाँकी क्रेडिट (Carry-forward credit) — ZeroBook does not mirror the IRD credit ledger, and whether prior excess credit was carried forward or refunded is a taxpayer decision. Supplied as an explicit input, default 0.
8/9/10 कर फिर्ता माग / आधार / जम्मा भुक्तानी + भौचर नं. — refund claim, its basis, and the payment voucher are taxpayer actions taken on the portal; reported as 0 / unticked / blank.
11.4 क्रेडिट एडभाइस संख्या / 11.5 डेविट एडभाइस संख्या — ZeroBook has no 'advice' document type; reported as 0.
नाम / ठेगाना / टेलिफोन नं. / मोबाइल नं. — no per-tenant business name, address or phone is stored in the tenant database (company_features holds only company_pan). Emitted as null and flagged.

declaration.np: यस कर विवरणमा उल्लेख गरिएको जानकारी सत्य र पूरा भएको व्यहोरा प्रमाणित गर्दछु।

declaration.note: The declaration block (करदाताको USER ID / नाम, थर / हस्ताक्षर / पद / मिति) and the 'कार्यालय प्रयोजनको लागि मात्र' (office use only) block are signature/office fields. They are not part of the computed return data and ZeroBook does not populate them.
